title: SemProxy: Semantic 3D Proxies for Controllable Agentic 3D Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.34414v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Coding agents are increasingly capable of generating 3D models, yet enabling users to effectively control the modeling process remains challenging. Existing workflows rely primarily on text prompts and reference images, which often struggle to convey precise spatial intentions and require iterative corrections. We introduce SemProxy, a lightweight intermediate representation that bridges intuitive human interaction and agentic 3D modeling. Instantiated as labeled 3D bounding boxes, semantic 3D proxies allow users to directly specify object parts and spatial arrangements while leaving geometric details to coding agents. These proxies can be serialized into structured text and rendered as images, making them directly accessible to existing coding agents without additional training or modifications. translated_title: SemProxy：用于可控智能体3D建模的语义3D代理
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.34414v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：编码智能体（coding agents）生成3D模型的能力日益增强，但如何让用户有效地控制建模过程仍然具有挑战性。现有工作流程主要依赖文本提示和参考图像，这些方式往往难以传达精确的空间意图，并且需要反复修正。我们提出了SemProxy，这是一种轻量级的中间表示，连接了直观的人机交互与智能体3D建模。通过实例化为带标签的3D包围框，语义3D代理允许用户直接指定物体的部件和空间布局，同时将几何细节留给编码智能体处理。这些代理可以被序列化为结构化文本并渲染为图像，使现有的编码智能体无需额外的训练或修改即可直接使用。我们还开发了ProxyStudio，这是一个将文本、图像参考和交互式3D代理编辑集成到智能体建模中的用户界面。
tldr: 提出SemProxy，一种以带标签3D包围框形式表示的轻量级语义代理中间表示，让用户通过直接指定物体部件和空间布局来可控地引导编码智能体进行3D建模，且无需训练即可兼容现有智能体。
en_tdlr: SemProxy introduces lightweight semantic 3D proxies (labeled bounding boxes) as an intermediate representation, enabling users to directly control agentic 3D modeling by specifying object parts and spatial layouts while remaining compatible with existing coding agents without additional training.
